mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) relative to its 3-month moving average compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below its 3-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 8.0% signals a weak labor market and potential economic slowdown, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 8.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline (3-month change < 0).

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL) above 3.0% signals an elevated risk of monetary tightening, which compresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) relative to its 12-month average indicates robust economic activity, supporting corporate earnings and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO is above its 12-month average.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate (GDPC1) below 1.0% signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings growth is expected to slow.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 < 1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating job growth (PAYEMS 3-month growth > 0.5%) signals a strengthening labor market and economic recovery, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS 3-month growth > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates a broad-based economic slowdown, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both INDPRO and HOUST decline (3-month change < 0).
